subject: Request: hostedapi onboarding concession — CloudLane marketplace
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: hostedapi onboarding concession — CloudLane marketplace

Lauren,

Quick one — CloudLane (marketplace partner) is asking for a deeper onboarding concession so they can list Redwood as the preferred inference provider in their partner marketplace. They are offering a co-marketing package and early access placement; this is strategic for expanding our marketplace channel.

As discussed on the call, their economics:
- Committed 12-month initial term
- Estimated monthly consumed tokens: 1.8B in months 2-6, then 2.5B steady state
- Expected ARR (net of discount) ~ $420k/yr first 12 months

They are pushing for a 30% off list-rate for Hosted API usage for the first 6 months, with the option to re-evaluate at month 6. Standard guidance puts us at 15% for partner onboarding; customer is requesting above the 20% exec threshold.

Attachments: usage forecast and draft SOW (CloudLane_SOW_v1.pdf, CloudLane_usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx).

Ask: can you review and either sign off or escalate to Execs for approval? If escalated, I recommend approving up to 30% for the first 6 months conditional on: 12-month commit, co-marketing slot, and HubSpot deal stage updated with final SOW.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hostedapi onboarding concession — CloudLane marketplace

Ben —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick notes:
- Economic model looks plausible but we need the ARR line items in the workbook separated (hosted tokens vs support/consulting).
- 30% is above our standard partner onboarding cap. Anything above 20% requires Exec approval per the discount policy.
- If accurate usage comes in, approving a 25-30% short-term concession (first 3–6 months) tied to firm product placement and a 12-month commit could be defensible as a strategic investment.

Please update the forecast sheet with net ARR and margin impact (we need to justify to Finance) and confirm whether CloudLane will sign the SOW with Redwood branding clauses unchanged. Once those are in, I will escalate to Karthik and loop Rishi for exec sign-off.

Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hostedapi onboarding concession — CloudLane marketplace

Adding the requested breakdown — attached updated workbook has: hosted revenue, services, and estimated margin impact by month.

Customer confirmation on SOW: CloudLane legal has reviewed; they are comfortable with our standard branding and data-use clauses and will sign once pricing is finalized. They also confirmed the co-marketing package includes a dedicated blog post, a featured placement in the CloudLane marketplace for 90 days, and joint webinar commitment.

Risk notes: they will prioritize listing providers who sign the onboarding concession. If we decline, they will likely select an alternative inference provider with lower margins but immediate marketplace listing.

Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: CloudLane onboarding concession (exec approval requested)

Rishi / Lauren —

Escalating the CloudLane onboarding concession for exec approval. Summary:
- Ask: One-time 30% discount on Hosted API usage for months 1–6, then revert to standard partner rate (approx 12–15%).
- Commit: 12-month minimum term; CloudLane agrees to co-marketing package with featured placement and a joint webinar; legal signoff pending pricing finalization.
- Expected impact: ~$420k ARR first year (net of discount), but high strategic value via marketplace channel and potential pipeline from referrals.
- Net margin impact: see attached workbook (sent earlier) — short-term margin compression, long-term upside through channel movement.

Recommended approval: approve up to 30% for first 6 months subject to: signed SOW, HubSpot deal updated with committed token floor, and monthly usage reviews with the account team. If you prefer a smaller concession, 25% for 6 months with a 9-month commit is an alternative.

Please advise final sign-off or alternate concession level.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: CloudLane onboarding concession (exec approval requested)

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve a one-time 30% Hosted API usage concession for months 1–4 (not 6), with the following conditions:

1) Signed 12-month SOW in place before any concession is applied.
2) Co-marketing deliverables confirmed in writing (blog + marketplace feature + webinar).
3) Deal registered in HubSpot (deal ID CL-2026-031) with a committed monthly token floor and automatic reversion to standard partner pricing after month 4.
4) Finance to be copied on the first invoice for audit and margin tracking.

If the account team needs more runway beyond month 4, come back with a usage review and specific milestone (e.g., 90-day marketplace traffic threshold). I am not approving open-ended 30% for 6 months at this time.

Ben — please relay terms to CloudLane and attach the final SOW; Lauren and Finance will coordinate the margin monitoring.

Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
